messages:
olivia (PM): quick check-in before we freeze scope: we need an ops-acceptance checklist for reserved pools + burst credits. goal: ship MVP with soft-spillover and paid prewarm.

ben (Eng): agree. runtime needs: O(1) quota check, per-tenant token buckets, and per-pool KV isolation. implementation behind a feature flag to canary.

harpreet (SRE): ops acceptance items: dashboards for contested pools, automated rollback if p99 latency rises >20% for 10m, and an incident template to notify affected customers.

maria (Sales): customer asks: clear UI showing burst balance + invoice preview. enterprise customers want paid prewarm pricing and ability to opt into stricter guarantees.

phil (Data): telemetry gates: emit pool_id, tenant_id, burst_balance, burst_consumed, spillover_count, p95/p99_latency. need these in ingest by canary start.

olivia (PM): launch gates proposal: (1) canary 48h with staging replay, p95 delta <= 12%; (2) burst hit-rate >= 94% for credited requests; (3) invoice preview + billing mapping implemented; (4) runbook + dashboards ready and reviewed.

ben (Eng): plan: shim in runtime -> PR by 2026-05-02, feature-flagged. will include microbench numbers.

harpreet (SRE): owner: runbook + dashboard by 2026-05-04. will add safety circuit: if cluster GPU util > 85% then throttle non-premium bursts.

maria (Sales): owner: sample SLA text + pricing tiers by 2026-05-06. will flag accounts that need hard preempt later.

phil (Data): owner: telemetry schema push by 2026-05-03.

olivia (PM): risks: 1) customer confusion about "best-effort" burst, 2) latency regressions from runtime checks, 3) billing disputes on partial spillover. mitigations: clear UI text, canary + rollback, and billing dispute playbook.

ben (Eng): approve MVP without hard preempt, but must keep hooks for future opt-in. :thumbsup:

harpreet (SRE): :thumbsup:

maria (Sales): :thumbsup: (noting two accounts want hard preempt eventually)

deploybot: Feature flags updated: reserved-pools-v1 = off, runtime-shim = staged.
